# T-2: Prevent invalid cache writes

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure parse-invalid docs.text batch responses are not persisted to active-flow prompt cache.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A non-JSON docs.text response that fails parse is not written to .senti/agent-cache.
- Successful cacheable responses remain reusable.

## Implementation Notes
Choose a bounded mechanism that lets docs.text parse failure mark the relevant response non-cacheable without disabling cache globally.

## Test Strategy
Unit test active-flow cache behavior with a parse-invalid response and assert no cache entry is stored for that response.
